item.tib: gsang chen seng ge sgra sgrogs las sri mnan rdo rje 'bar ba'i rgya can
item.coloph: ces pa'ang rigs ldan mkha' 'gro'i ('gros) grogs byas nas/ 'phags yul bsil ba tshal nas dngos grub thob mthar lo dus kyi bka' rgya yol tshe/ dad ldan grogs kyis bskul ma byung ba'i rkyen gyis yig lam du phab grub pa byas pas/ snyigs ma'i rgud pa bcil ba'i dpal du 'gyur bar gyur cig/
